# CaulHaus

> CaulHaus connects your everyday tools and builds custom automations to eliminate manual busywork and messy spreadsheets.

## Overview
CaulHaus is led by Alex Herbstman, a systems developer and founder with over a decade of hands-on experience connecting tools and automating workflows, including three years building enterprise automation systems within an extended network inside one of the largest technology companies in the world.

Most teams lose hundreds of hours copying data between spreadsheets, chasing status updates, and doing repetitive tasks by hand because their software does not talk to each other. CaulHaus diagnoses your bottlenecks and writes working automations directly inside the tools you already use—no extra software subscriptions required.

## The Five Everyday Areas We Connect
CaulHaus organizes workflows and automations across five everyday areas:

1. Product & Design Hand-Offs: We automate moving user feedback, design assets, and feature requests to developers without manual chasing.
2. Vendors & Partners: We set up automated contract renewal reminders and streamline partner onboarding without endless email threads.
3. Marketing Plumbing & Leads: We build instant lead routing to deliver form submissions to sales reps in seconds, and track which marketing efforts actually generate revenue.
4. Everyday Team Busywork: We eliminate manual copy-pasting in Google Sheets, generate weekly reports automatically, and track team workloads.
5. Sales, Invoicing & Billing: We ensure signed deals automatically generate invoices and sync cleanly to customer CRM records.

## How We Work (/services/)
1. The 2-Week Workflow Audit: A focused two-week diagnostic to map your time-wasters, eliminate spreadsheet bottlenecks, and deliver your first working automation prototype.
2. Full Automation Build: End-to-end design and deployment of custom background automations and tool connections directly inside your software.
3. On-Call Support & Maintenance: Monthly on-call help to maintain existing workflows, adapt to tool updates, and build new automations as your business grows.

## Track Record & Impact
- We built and rolled out a Google Workspace capacity planner across 17 teams and 37 people, recovering roughly 590 hours a month in saved manual status chasing.
- We build directly on top of your existing tools (Google Workspace, CRM, project trackers) without adding software fees.
